Inside a traditional Kabylie home in the mountains of Northern Algeria 🇩🇿 Kabylie is home to Algeria’s Amazigh people, and getting to step inside one of these homes gave me a glimpse into a way of life that has been passed down for generations. What makes these homes so unique is how they were traditionally built around everyday life, with livestock kept on the lower level and the family living above them. One of the most unique homes I’ve ever seen. 🇩🇿 #algeria #kabyle #solotravel #amazigh #kabylie
